body.statement: The \(L=8\) primitive character average in the displayed table yields \(\mathbb E[W_{j_1}\cdots W_{j_m}]=0\) for odd \(m\) and \(\mathbb E[W_{j_1}\cdots W_{j_m}]=\mathbf 1\{\bigoplus_rj_r=0\}(-1)^{\sum_r\phi_8(j_r)}\) for even \(m\). In particular, \(\mathbb E[W_0W_1W_2W_3]=-1\), \(M_8=\begin{psmallmatrix}1&0&-1\\0&0&0\\-1&0&5\end{psmallmatrix}\) for \(d=3\), and \(M_8+H_3=\begin{psmallmatrix}2&0&-1\\0&2&0\\-1&0&8\end{psmallmatrix}\).
body.justification: This worked block computes the fourth character tensor and lag-sum covariance from all eight affine masks rather than appealing only to a named Golay identity.
body.gap: Classical complementarity gives paired autocorrelation cancellation, whereas the table records the single randomized block's coefficient-level fourth moments and the exact covariance needed by the causal risk.
body.consumer: It is the small-block audit for the stationary construction and isolates sign, bit-order, and endpoint conventions before the general proof.
